query:
SELECT CONCAT(state_code, ' Senate') as race, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, ROUND(candidate1_vote_pct,1) as c1pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, ROUND(candidate2_vote_pct,1) as c2pct,
       pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, called_winner, status
FROM senate_races WHERE state_code IN ('WV','OH')
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT(state_code, ' Senate') as race, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, ROUND(candidate1_vote_pct,1) as c1pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, ROUND(candidate2_vote_pct,1) as c2pct,
       pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, called_winner, status
FROM senate_races WHERE state_code = 'OH' AND is_special = 1
ORDER BY race;
